from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """
    Captures the necessary financial metrics for one company found in a document.
    The parser extracts these fields per document; the inference agent aggregates
    across all documents to perform quartile classification and ranking.
    """
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company as reported")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock or trading code of the company")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets value in currency units")
    fixed_assets: float | None = Field(description="Fixed assets value in currency units")
    weighted_average_roe: float | None = Field(description="Weighted Average Return on Net Assets (percentage)")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period date string (e.g., YYYY-MM)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialData]
